== Notes ==
* Similarly to [[Ash Blast]], Freezing Gust does not count as a hex spell if the target is hexed with a Water Magic hex. Skills that check for hexed foes (e.g. [[Soul Barbs]]) or skills that trigger when the user casts a hex spell (e.g. [[Elemental Flame]]) do not trigger if Freezing Gust hits a target hexed with a Water Magic hex.
